g.title: prepared
g.text: Cloud image, updated, with the test dependencies
Updated every 12 h, made anew every 7 days
from a cloud image downloaded anew
No build dependencies: the test VM starts from it

g.title: buildimg
g.text: A layer over the prepared image with the build dependencies
Made again whenever the prepared image changes

g.title: fast
g.text: FAST=1 uses one VM for build and test
